Nvidia halts chip shipments to four Southeast Asian countries

Nvidia has halted sales to Southeast Asia as the U.S. tightens China restrictions. The shipping halt hit four countries. It follows a new U.S. rule that would require licenses for companies in those countries to buy advanced A.I. chips.

Reported by The New York Times; FT; The Decoder. Written by AI.
